text:
ana: quick thread 7 enterprise asked for a playbook: tie route-level cost spikes to error postmortems. want a short operational spec + launch checks. rough draft below.
mike: neat. can we include an automated incident export (route, cost delta, sample traces) so eng and finance can use same artifact?
sasha: storage caution: exporting full traces for every incident is heavy. suggest exported incident contains sampled trace ids + a short trace excerpt (redacted) and a link to full trace if retained.
praveen: impl note: compute cost delta at aggregation boundaries so we avoid per-token heavy math. emit compact incident envelope async to avoid sync latency.
joan: product constraints: RBAC (billing vs eng vs SRE), downloadable CSV for finance, and redaction/KMS for Private installs. these are GA blockers for enterprise customers.
sam: UX idea: incident card in Console with 3 tabs: summary (cost + routes), timeline (latency/error overlays), traces (sampled excerpts). export button up top.
ana: (typo 7 ana) proposed incident envelope fields: tenant, route, time window, cost_delta_estimate, tokens_delta, model_variant, top_errors_count, sampled_trace_ids, redaction_flag. keep it tiny.
mike: Can we add a "confidence" score for cost delta (low/med/high) so finance knows how raw the estimate is?
sasha: yes, but compute confidence from sampling rate + QPS variance. include sampling_rate used.
praveen: sampling policy: default low baseline, always sample errors and anomaly-detected requests. example we can surface:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.0005
  error: 1.0
  anomaly: 1.0
  routes:
    "/v1/generate": 0.005
```
we should make sampling visible in incident export.
joan: launch criteria draft:
- functional: incident export includes route-level cost delta + sampled traces
- perf: instrumentation overhead <10% CPU on dataplane under typical load
- economics: telemetry storage delta <+12% infra spend first qtr; guardrail +25% requires exec signoff
- security: redaction + KMS tagging for Private deployments
- UX: incident card + CSV export + short doc for finance
- rollout: staged canary tenants -> grad increase; auto rollback if infra spend >18% during canary
mike: canary plan: 5 tenants synth+real traffic x 72h, check p50/p95, cost variance, export integrity. thresholds: p95 regressions <5%, error uplift <0.2pp, infra spend delta <15%.
sasha: retention & cost: sampled trace excerpts kept 30d, full sampled traces 14d, indexed aggregates 90d. default compression + dedupe enabled. need tuning knobs exposed.
praveen: perf detail: apply per-route pre-sampling and use a tiny protobuf envelope; batch write to blob store and index async. avoid blocking request path.
sam: ops playbook steps for a detected spike: 1) run incident export -> 2) open incident card and assign to oncall -> 3) finance tag + attach CSV -> 4) sample trace review + root cause note. we should ship a one-click "create incident" from Console.
joan: prioritization: top-10 customer request. recommend P0. attach customer vignette to PRD.
observability-bot: created issue #5110 "console: cost-error incident export + playbook" and assigned to @ana @mike @sasha. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/issues/5110
ana: next steps: mike -> incident card + export proto (due Tue); praveen -> proto envelope + perf simulation (due Wed); sasha -> storage cost model + retention knobs (due Fri); joan -> RBAC/export/redaction checklist + vignette (due 5d). will schedule 30m follow-up after artifacts land. thanks :thumbsup:
